test.create_query: CREATE TABLE coalesce_short_circuit (n_10 Nullable(UInt64), n_50 Nullable(UInt64), n_100 Nullable(UInt64), s String) ENGINE = Memory
test.query: SELECT sum(toInt8(if(number % 2, CAST('a' AS Enum8('a' = 0, 'b' = 1)), CAST(number % 2 AS Enum8('a' = 0, 'b' = 1))))) FROM numbers(100000000)
SELECT sum(toInt8(if(number % 2, CAST('a' AS Enum8('a' = 1, 'b' = 2)), CAST(number % 2 + 1 AS Enum8('a' = 1, 'b' = 2))))) FROM numbers(100000000)
SELECT count() FROM coalesce_short_circuit WHERE coalesce(CAST(n_50 % 2 + 1 AS Nullable(Enum8('a' = 1, 'b' = 2))), CAST(length(s) % 2 + 1 AS Enum8('a' = 1, 'b' = 2))) = 'a'
